history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY — no address-level documentation found for a 'Durg Devi Temple' in Bhilai. The name appears in a travel guide's list of top Bhilai places to visit ('a spiritual destination attracting devotees from across the region'). Possible candidates include Durga Mandir, Ram Nagar (Ekta Durga Utsav Samiti, open 6 AM-8 PM) and Maa Jagdamba Mandir, Sector 6 — no source confirms either as the CSV's referent. Coordinates below are Bhilai town-centre approximate; no on-topic image could be verified, so media is empty.

name: Durg Devi Temple
town_description: Bhilai is an industrial city in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, built around the Bhilai Steel Plant (commissioned 1959 with Soviet collaboration); its planned sectors and township host numerous temples serving the steel-town population.
